summary.headline: Seven Ages of the World
summary.text: Lunar omens for Aquarius and Pisces cover eclipses, earthquakes, sounds, fog, grain, disease, fruit, and cattle, followed by a notice introducing “On the seven ages of the world.” The introduction compares Mutinensis, Neapolitan codex 19, and Vatican codex 191 traditions, cites Aemygdius Martini, Dominicus Bassi, Pitra, Firmicus Maternus, and Hephaestio, and discusses planetary chronocratory.
